semiconductor_relevance: High — Reid-Ashman Manufacturing provides critical equipment for semiconductor testing, specifically manipulators and docking stations for test heads.
summary: Reid-Ashman Manufacturing specializes in producing manipulators for various types of test heads used in semiconductor testing. Their product range includes manipulators designed for different test head types and weights, as well as Pogo-towers and Probe Interface Boards that ensure high bandwidth signal integrity for high pin count test heads.
technical_expertise: Mechanical design for test head manipulators
Signal integrity for high pin count test interfaces
